talents.name: Divine Intellect
talents.description: Increases your total Intellect by 2/4/6/8/10% (por rango).

talents.name: Healing Light
talents.description: Increases the amount healed by Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock by 4/8/12% (por rango). Requiere 5 pts en Sagrado.

talents.name: Spiritual Focus
talents.description: Gives Flash of Light, Holy Light and Light's Vigil a 35/70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage. Requiere 5 pts.

talents.name: Improved Seals
talents.description: Increases the damage done by Seals and Judgements by 5/10/15% (por rango). Requiere 5 pts.

talents.name: Unyielding Faith
talents.description: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects by 15/30%. Requiere 5 pts.

talents.name: Voice of Truth
talents.description: Instant, 3 min cd. Grants immunity to Silence and Interrupt for 6 sec. Requiere 10 pts.

talents.name: Reverence
talents.description: Allows 10/20/30% of Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Habilita Illumination. Requiere 10 pts.

talents.name: Purifying Power
talents.description: Cleanse/Purify -10/20% mana; Exorcism/Holy Wrath -17/33% cooldown. Requiere 10 pts.

talents.name: Infusion of Light
talents.description: Holy Shock / Flash of Light crits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light within 15 sec by 0.5/1.0 sec. Requiere 15 pts.

talents.name: Illumination
talents.description: Crit heal (Flash/Holy Light/Light's Vigil/Holy Shock): 20/40/60/80/100% chance to gain Mana = 50% of base cost. Requiere Reverence al maximo + 15 pts.

talents.name: Divine Favor
talents.description: 37 Mana, Instant, 2 min cd. Next Flash of Light / Holy Light / Holy Shock crits 100%. Requiere 15 pts.

talents.name: Divine Precision
talents.description: Holy spell hit +6/12/18%. Requiere Holy Shock + 20 pts. OJO: mismo nivel que su requisito (r5), verificar flecha en Wowhead.

talents.name: Holy Shock
talents.description: 160 Mana, 20 range, Instant, 10 sec cd. 134 Holy damage to enemy or 114 healing to ally. Talento dorado ~21 pts. Requiere 20 pts.

talents.name: Consecrated Ground
talents.description: Holy spells +5/10% damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration. Requiere 20 pts.

talents.name: Holy Power
talents.description: Holy Shock / Holy Strike crit +3/6/9/12/15%, all other spells +1/2/3/4/5%. Requiere 25 pts.

talents.name: Light's Vigil
talents.description: 730 Mana, 20 range, 1.5 sec cast, 6 sec cd. Light's Vigil 30 sec; next Holy Shock: no cd, 182 damage + 75% mana refund (enemigo) o cura al party por 324 (aliado). Uno por party. Capstone ~31 pts. Requiere Holy Shock + 30 pts.
